Your one job

Build the minimum features the business needs, not the maximum features AI can invent.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    List each page, the primary customer goal, forms, booking/payment actions and integrations.

  2. 02

    Write acceptance criteria for mobile usability, service information, form submission and success messages.

  3. 03

    Keep a clear list of features excluded from version one.

  4. 04

    Choose simple static pages for a marketing site; use a database/backend only if operations actually require it.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Turn this approved prototype and business plan into a production website brief. List public pages, navigation, content, real images, CTAs, forms and integrations. Separately mark required versus later features. Define measurable acceptance tests for mobile UX, accessibility, payment/enquiry flow and privacy. Prefer static HTML or a simple CMS unless true app features demand more.
03

Finish with this

Scoped website specification and release-one acceptance checklist.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Required and deferred features are separated
  • Every form has an owner and completion behavior
  • No unapproved features are silently added
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Making a complex web app when a fast landing page would sell the service.

READY TO MOVE ON?

A real customer completes a verified lead or checkout flow; admin access and customer data are protected.
